title: A small repair cafe
description: A short fictional demonstration, not a factual report.

sections.heading: The shared table
paragraphs: This is a fictional demonstration of a community repair cafe. Neighbours bring broken lamps and learn how to fix them together.

sections.heading: What the example does not claim
paragraphs: No interviews or field recordings were used. The example does not estimate costs or claim that every repair succeeds.
